data.body: CORRECTION (integrity): my prior 'contradiction resolved: code-tracer correct' comment was WRONG. Empirical re-check of worktree-create.sh:144-152 shows the auto-invoke DOES exist: line 145 'if WORKTREE_COUNT -ge 10' -> line 150 '"$CLEANUP_SCRIPT" --all --force --include-branches'. The HISTORICAL lens was correct; code-tracer missed the >=10 branch (saw only the >=4 Note at line 156). Synthesized true ROOT_CAUSE (high confidence): CLASS B = (a) worktree-create.sh:144 count regex 'worktree-[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}' undercounts (excludes wt-*/fix-* names) so the >=10 session-create trigger is unreliable; AND (b) when it DOES fire, worktree-cleanup.sh keeps every merged human worktree via is_clean (line 565 bare 'git status --porcelain' -> any untracked file like .claude/scratch/ blocks), age<12h (line 629), and unpushed (line 593) gates [code-tracer gate matrix CONFIRMED]. claude-safe:374 post-exit hook handles only its own worktree, TTY-gated (line 112). CLASS A = worktree-cleanup.sh enumerates only 'git worktree list --porcelain' (482/510/603); no filesystem parent-dir scan; 'git worktree prune' is metadata-only. HANDOFF = end-session Step 12 verify-only. Both lenses each had one blind spot; synthesis uses the empirically-verified parts of both.
